verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a feature-flag and experimentation SaaS, so the axis applies, but no evidence shows Statsig ships a self-hostable version of its platform. Warehouse Native only runs analysis in the customer's own warehouse, and SDKs evaluate locally after initialization; both are adjacent behaviors, not self-hosting the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
